upstream.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Talk via WhatsApp, Telegram or Web.

classification.analysis: Clawdis is a self-hosted personal AI assistant with a TypeScript Gateway control plane (WebSocket/TCP) that connects a Pi agent runtime to multiple surfaces: WhatsApp, Telegram, WebChat, a macOS menu-bar app with voice wake and push-to-talk, and paired iOS/Android nodes with a live Canvas UI. It supports browser control, cron/scheduling, group chat activation rules, and Gmail-triggered wake hooks, aiming to be a single-user, local-first assistant that feels always-on across devices. The repository has almost no external adoption (4 stars) and shows no commit activity beyond its initial push.

use_cases.title: Run a self-hosted AI assistant reachable via WhatsApp and Telegram
Add voice wake and push-to-talk to a personal agent on macOS
Pair a phone as a remote node for camera/screen agent commands
Trigger an agent workflow from an incoming Gmail message
